counting_unit: Packets are bounded implementation/review units; source-row mappings overlap and are not distinct algorithm counts or completion percentages.
validity: Applies to the recorded source/test snapshot and explicit native profiles. Re-run after changes. Later upstream releases and untested external corpora are not covered.
test_execution: This registry does not assert test execution. Use the tracked implementation report for final aggregate validation results.
global_limits: Full PM4Py/OCPA reference variant parity and user domain acceptance remain pending.
W5 reference/corpus/scale acceptance is not completed by structural API registration.
Performance, real-world predictive accuracy and arbitrary external-model interoperability rates are unknown.
No autonomous external action execution or Schumpeter controller is implemented by these calculation profiles.

packets.title: Explicit model capabilities and occurrence-level relabeling
packets.exact_native_profile: Immutable capability catalog and explicit label operations for P/T, OCPN, tree, POWL and restricted BPMN; colliding labels retain separate occurrences.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Capability lookup is a declaration about a model family, not soundness or instance executability. Label support is a proper subset of persisted families.
remaining_limits: No generic field rewriting or label operations for every persisted model family.
No upstream object/API or NetworkX format parity.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the relevant declaration if a published callable stops resolving, an occurrence is merged, or relabeling changes incidence/markings.

packets.title: Reset/inhibitor and stochastic model contracts
packets.exact_native_profile: Exclusive input arc kinds; consume-reset-produce firing with pre-state inhibitor tests. Persisted stochastic parameters have separate weight/duration origins and local weighted-choice serial steps.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Data guards remain a separate existing type. Local stochastic steps are not a concurrent timing law; reservation timing is separately registered below.
remaining_limits: Ordinary P/T algorithms reject wrappers that would lose extended semantics.
No timed race/GSPN priorities or complete extended-net analysis.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if stated token arithmetic, inhibitor thresholds, parameter persistence or wrapper rejection fails.

packets.title: Bounded PNML, PTML and BPMN model exchange
packets.exact_native_profile: PNML ordinary weighted accepting P/T with explicit final marking; PTML binary loop plus tau exit; BPMN single plain start/end, atomic tasks and XOR/AND. Typed provenance and atomic file publication.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: These are named syntax/semantics profiles, not complete standard implementations or arbitrary upstream export interoperability.
remaining_limits: PNML extended arcs and absent/multiple final markings are rejected.
BPMN conditions, inclusive/event gateways, subprocesses, DI and unknown extensions are rejected.
Byte-identical XML round-trip and arbitrary external-corpus compatibility are not established.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw a preservation claim if a supported round-trip changes IDs, labels, weights, markings or accepted behavior.

packets.title: Series-parallel POWL to process tree
packets.exact_native_profile: Occurrence-preserving recursive series/parallel partial-order decomposition with XOR/loop/tau retained.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Adds one directional structural profile; existing POWL-to-net support is separate.
remaining_limits: N-shaped non-series-parallel orders return unavailable, without arbitrary sequencing or duplicated activities.
No universal POWL/tree inverse or source-log lineage.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if a supported occurrence order or bounded visible language differs from an independent oracle.

packets.title: Transition-bordered process tree to Petri net
packets.exact_native_profile: Each tree occurrence has transition entry/exit boundaries; compositional sequence/XOR/parallel/binary-loop constructions and occurrence witnesses.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: This implements the named transition-bordered direction; does not assert identity-name or all-option parity.
remaining_limits: Only native ProcessTree operators; bounded construction.
Timing, probability and upstream statistics are not preserved by a control-flow construction.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if an independently enumerated supported visible word is gained or lost, or occurrence boundaries are inconsistent.

packets.title: Finite prefix trie to accepting Petri net
packets.exact_native_profile: Validated full-prefix TransitionSystem; each edge has its own transition and only observed terminal states terminate, including epsilon.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Covers the trie member of the source row, not arbitrary merged transition systems or every GeneticMatrix conversion.
remaining_limits: Requires complete count-conserving full-prefix input; partial or windowed/merged graphs are rejected.
Frequencies are retained evidence, not probabilities or arc weights.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if the resulting net accepts a word not in a terminal context or loses an observed terminal word.

packets.title: Maximal structural decomposition and exact recomposition
packets.exact_native_profile: Finest allowed unit-arc ordinary-net ownership partition; shared globally unique visible transitions synchronize and duplicate labels/silent transitions stay together.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: This is structural decomposition with exact recomposition, not decomposed alignment border-disagreement search.
remaining_limits: Weighted arcs are unavailable.
Isolated-node retention is a declared extension of the incident-net construction.
No automatic soundness, boundedness or alignment certificate.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if a valid finer partition exists under the same constraints, recomposition changes the net, or synchronized/global firing differs.

packets.title: Weighted P/T coverability and boundedness
packets.exact_native_profile: Classical Karp-Miller tree with ancestor acceleration, omega, concrete first-pumping witnesses, place bounds and conditional target/dead-transition decisions.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Supports specific boundedness/coverability questions within the broader WOFLAN source row; it is not WOFLAN parity.
remaining_limits: Coverability is not exact reachability, liveness or general workflow soundness.
Search caps preserve unknown assessments unless a positive proof is already present.
Reset/inhibitor/colored semantics are excluded.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the respective proof claim if an independent coverability oracle or executable pumping witness disagrees.

packets.title: Typed local subprocess and transformation pipeline
packets.exact_native_profile: Type-restricted directed-walk interval with synchronization cuts, original IDs/cardinalities, inside/outside marking ledger; optional project-restrict-hide-reduce.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: The output is a structural selection. Original process language preservation or standalone subprocess soundness is not inferred.
remaining_limits: Projection can cut cross-type synchronization and keeps that loss explicit.
Reduction preservation applies only to its already-projected input.
No automatic token seeding at chosen boundaries.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if independent type-restricted reachability, marking partition or synchronization-cut accounting differs.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing projection, hiding and reduction profiles are reused.

packets.title: Explicit strict optional-block inductive profile
packets.exact_native_profile: Explicit IM/IMf/IMd strict-sequence optional-interval contraction while the persisted legacy plain-sequence profile stays unchanged.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Pinned strict-cut comparisons support this refinement, not all PM4Py miner variants or global model precision.
remaining_limits: IMd cannot reconstruct correlations lost in DFG input.
IMf may filter observations; strict sequence still generalizes rather than memorizing the full language.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if a supported strict-cut counterexample or legacy persisted-identity regression is reproduced.

packets.title: Cutoff observations, censored targets and leakage-safe encoders
packets.exact_native_profile: One cutoff per call; explicit observation/completion/horizon facts; indivisible shared/time blocks; train-only vocabulary/IDF; known-value masks and separate sequence padding.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Named native observation contracts complement existing feature encoders; this is not an assertion of every default PM4Py feature formula.
remaining_limits: No per-case multi-landmark cutoff API or time-aware trace-attribute as-of joins.
Shared groups and label-availability times must be supplied accurately.
Event globals are assumed timeless; actual information arrival times are not inferred.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if future-only data changes fitted inputs, supplied groups cross partitions, censorship is presented as completion, or missing/padding values become known zeroes.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing feature vocabulary, n-grams, TF-IDF and numerical encoders.

packets.title: Object k-step data, inverse encoding and linear regression
packets.exact_native_profile: K distinct timestamp groups retain ties; targets are strictly later; numeric OLS and MAE with explicit object/event/execution training scopes and held-out entity checks.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Complements existing OC feature extraction/encoding/splitting. Entity-disjoint evaluation is not causal or prospective independence.
remaining_limits: Global-context features and retrospectively extracted executions may require further prospective feature design.
Numeric inverse results use floating-point and cannot promise exact very-large integer restoration.
No nonlinear predictor family, automatic causal feature selection or arbitrary external ML estimator API.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if tied events gain an invented order, training entities overlap a declared held-out cohort, or independent OLS/MAE arithmetic differs.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing event/execution feature graphs, aggregation, encoding and train-only normalization.

packets.title: Held-out mixed-feature decision evaluation
packets.exact_native_profile: Train-only categorical vocabulary/numeric CART, whole-case/group disjointness, confusion/accuracy and explicit retained versus complete-population coverage.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Automatic conformance-derived observations currently use numeric prefix features; generic explicit categorical rows have a separate caller contract.
remaining_limits: No automatic categorical conformance extraction or guarantee that external rows were available before outcomes.
No automatic cross-validation/model selection or causal explanation.
Incomplete upstream populations withhold complete-coverage claims.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if held-out values change fitted vocabulary/tree, supplied groups cross the split, or known missing observations produce complete coverage.

packets.title: Bose drift multiplicity adjustment
packets.exact_native_profile: Exact rational Holm/BH/none arithmetic over the declared full hypothesis family, with conservative bounds and unresolved decisions for incomplete families.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: This is adjustment of the existing native Bose diagnostic; exact arithmetic does not establish validity of raw permutation p-values or real process change.
remaining_limits: FWER/FDR interpretations require valid p-values and the declared family; BH further requires independence or PRDS.
Overlapping windows do not establish these assumptions.
Monte Carlo raw tests remain Monte Carlo.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the numerical claim if an independent adjustment oracle differs; withdraw error-control interpretation when its assumptions fail.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing raw Bose windows/permutation profile is retained.

packets.title: Existing clustering and stochastic-language distance
packets.exact_native_profile: Native named trace/vector/profile clustering and finite stochastic-language transport profiles already implemented before this increment.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Recorded as supporting existing W4 coverage, not newly implemented or certified upstream equivalent.
remaining_limits: Not every upstream clustering option or embedding family is covered.
Finite/truncated language inputs cannot certify equality of arbitrary infinite model languages.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the relevant profile claim if an independent distance, merge or transport-cost oracle disagrees.

packets.title: Existing finite case playout and artificial tree generation
packets.exact_native_profile: Existing bounded PN/tree/DFG generation, weighted finite DFG enumeration, DFG durations and seeded process-tree generation.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: These existing native profiles provide work-plan coverage; random/sample policy names do not assert upstream random-stream parity.
remaining_limits: Generated models are not evidence of real-process representativeness.
Bounds can leave unobserved behavior; simulation does not prove soundness.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if an emitted completed run violates its declared model/ending condition or a documented seeded/profile contract changes.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing bounded Declare-language generation remains a separate finite profile.

packets.title: Existing object binding playout
packets.exact_native_profile: Finite seeded OCPN and object-centric causal-net playout using concrete object binding contracts.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: This is existing object-aware playout, not case flattening or reference numerical parity.
remaining_limits: Bounded sampled runs do not enumerate every binding or certify arbitrary-net soundness.
No concurrent timed object-binding simulation is implied.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if a returned accepted run violates the declared binding or final-state rule.

packets.title: Concurrent reservation timed Petri-net playout
packets.exact_native_profile: Nonpreemptive input-token reservation at start, delayed output at completion, completion batches before dispatch and final marking only with no in-flight work.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Dispatch weights are choices, not exponential race rates. This is a named native stochastic-net timing profile.
remaining_limits: No GSPN priorities, preemption/cancellation, resource calendars or object binding.
Finite binary64 time and runtime-specific seeded RNG; horizon/start limits preserve censored runs.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if tokens are double-consumed, outputs appear early, in-flight work is accepted as complete or tied completion batching is violated.

packets.title: Multi-resource calendars, duration fitting and what-if
packets.exact_native_profile: Atomic multi-resource nonpreemptive jobs on absolute windows/capacities, feasible FIFO backfill, keyed duration draws, paired completed-cohort comparisons and explicit lifecycle fit exclusions.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Sequential operation routes are supplied; this is not a general stochastic-PN solver or proof of intervention effectiveness.
remaining_limits: No recurrent weekly/DST calendars, preemption, skill routing or inferred arrival/route model.
Common random numbers do not guarantee variance reduction for every distribution family.
Suspended/resumed intervals without known active service duration are excluded from fitting.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if capacity/calendar constraints fail, a partial acquisition blocks work, an input case disappears or dispatch order changes keyed service draws.

packets.title: Retained-fact case stream corrections and checkpoint
packets.exact_native_profile: Explicit process ordering, event CAS/tombstones, operation/offset deduplication, full retained-fact DFG recomputation with count retractions and replay-verified checkpoint.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Adds late/correction behavior beyond the source stream rows; it does not claim their API equivalence or replace the separate ordered CaseStream.
remaining_limits: Full retained data/history grow; not bounded-memory incremental or distributed durable streaming.
Open-case end counts describe current prefixes, not business completion.
Only minimal calculation event fields, not arbitrary XES attributes.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if retained-fact batch results differ, a rejected mutation consumes state/offset or checkpoint replay changes identity/counts.

packets.title: Canonical OC stream revisions and execution merge/split
packets.exact_native_profile: Canonical event/object/E2O facts, stream-wide CAS, opaque source offsets and revision journals; exact batch execution recomputation with explicit merge/split/overlap evidence.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: The closest stream source rows are transport/distribution infrastructure. This native OC revision profile is additional functionality, not a claim of OCEL-flattening distributor equivalence.
remaining_limits: No type-schema/O2O mutation API, broker, watermark service or crash-durable store.
Every correction recomputes retained facts; advanced analytics are not all automatically revised.
Leading-object overlap is not mislabeled as connected-component merge/split.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if canonical facts/qualifiers are lost, batch executions differ, rejected CAS changes state or replay differs.

packets.title: Existing ordered stream monitoring
packets.exact_native_profile: Existing ordered CaseStream with DFG, token replay, temporal, Declare and footprint state plus checkpoint contracts.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Separate ordered profile remains available; this row does not turn those monitors into revisable late-event analytics.
remaining_limits: Late/correction handling belongs to the new retained-fact engines, not this ordered profile.
No assertion of every upstream streaming adapter or approximate alignment variant.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if an accepted ordered input disagrees with the stated batch/profile contract or checkpoint restoration loses supported state.

supporting_existing_features.meaning: Existing bounded proxy/window online alignment is separate from revisable DFG recomputation; approximate semantics remain explicit.

packets.title: All-witness action matching and bounded exact planning
packets.exact_native_profile: Distinct slot-to-interval witnesses; required/optional partitions, precedence, pairwise conflicts, deadlines/horizon/costs and optional explicit objective; exhaustive bounded subset/order search.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Optimal means exact only for a complete supplied candidate catalog and this scheduling model. Witnesses are not authorization to execute.
remaining_limits: No cumulative capacity >1, preemption, calendar holes or time-dependent utility/cost.
Limited search preserves feasible/unknown and cannot certify global infeasibility/optimality.
No-op must still satisfy required obligations.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if a schedule violates declared constraints, independent exhaustive schedules improve a claimed optimum or a limited search falsely certifies infeasibility.

packets.title: Replay-verified operational population impact
packets.exact_native_profile: Reexecutes and verifies replay; compares typed distinct-object populations at event-count cutoffs before terminal finalization; separates observed-binding, silent, repaired and unknown evidence.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: State is conditional on the model, initial marking and deterministic replay. Scenario-minus-baseline is a population difference, not applying an action or causal counterfactual.
remaining_limits: Cutoffs are replay lexical-topological prefix counts, not timestamp cutoffs.
No physical-state measurement or enumeration of all nondeterministic markings.
Unknown placement withholds population totals/deltas instead of inventing zero.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if independent prefix token/object arithmetic, uncertainty propagation or signed deltas disagree, or a forged replay is accepted.

packets.title: Existing structural/performance impact and configuration
packets.exact_native_profile: Existing typed structural regions, observed before/after window metrics and immutable action-configuration updates.
packets.source_mapping_boundary: Configuration updates modify a calculation model; observed window differences are not causal effectiveness or external action execution.
remaining_limits: No external agent/controller deployment or automatic intervention.
Cohort, denominator and missing-value contracts remain explicit; confounding is not removed.
packets.withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if the declared structure/cohort/signed arithmetic or configuration identity is not preserved.

source_snapshot.meaning: Source identity only; not evidence that tests passed or semantics match.
